relations.subject: Johann Georg Martin DURSCH
relations.evidence: Studies at Tübingen, ordained as priest in 1825. Dr.theol. and Ph.D. 1825.

relations.subject: Johann Georg Martin DURSCH
relations.evidence: Then two and a half year studies of Oriental languages in Paris (under Chézy et al.).

relations.subject: Johann Georg Martin DURSCH
relations.evidence: After returning he worked first as a vicar and from 1828 as teacher at Gymnasium of Ehingen.
